items.source: Activates when there is no bean of type Neo4jRepositoryFactoryBean or Neo4jRepositoryConfigurationExtension configured in the context, the Spring Data Neo4j Neo4jRepository type is on the classpath, the Neo4j client driver API is on the classpath, and there is no other configured Neo4jRepository.
items.translation: 在上下文中未配置类型为Neo4jRepositoryFactoryBean或Neo4jRepositoryConfigurationExtension的 Bean，且类路径上存在 Spring Data Neo4j 的Neo4jRepository类型、Neo4j 客户端驱动程序 API，并且没有其他已配置的Neo4jRepository时激活。

items.source: Once in effect, the auto-configuration is the equivalent of enabling Neo4j repositories using the @EnableNeo4jRepositories annotation.
items.translation: 一旦生效，自动配置等同于使用 @EnableNeo4jRepositories` 注解启用 Neo4j 存储库。

items.source: Dave Syer, Oliver Gierke, Josh Long, Michael J. Simons
items.translation: Dave Syer、Oliver Gierke、Josh Long 和 Michael J. Simons
